question.problem:
Given the vector $x$ and the system of linear equations below, find the projection of $x$ onto the solution space of the system.

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 2 \\ -5\end{aligned}],\,\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-2{x}_{3}=0 \\ -2{x}_{1}+4{x}_{3}=0\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
First, we need to find a basis for the solution space of the system. 

Consider the augmented matrix $M$ of the system, which we reduce to row echelon form, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -2 & 0 \\ -2 & 0 & 4 & 0\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

In the reduced matrix above, there is $1$ pivot column (the $1$st one). Thus, ${x}_{2},\,{x}_{3}$ are free variables. Now, from the first equation, we get ${x}_{1}=2{x}_{3}.$ Therefore, the general solution is

$$
[\begin{aligned}2{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]={x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{x}_{2},\,{x}_{3}\in R.
$$

Consequently, $B=\{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]\}$ is the basis of the solution space of the system.

Now, we find the orthogonal projection of $x$ onto the solution space of the system:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{S}\,x & =A({A}^{T}\,A)^{-1}\,{A}^{T}\,x \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\cdot {([\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 0 \\ 2 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}])}^{-1}\cdot [\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 0 \\ 2 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 2 \\ -5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\cdot {[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 0 & 5\end{aligned}]}^{-1}\cdot [\begin{aligned}2 \\ -15\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\cdot \frac{1}{5}[\begin{aligned}5 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}2 \\ -15\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}2 \\ -3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-6 \\ 2 \\ -3\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
